title: Local abelianization of regular first-class constraints
statement: Given independent first-class constraints defining a regular coisotropic submanifold, can local canonical coordinates and an invertible change of constraint generators make all constraint brackets zero? This specifies the local reading of the notebook's question about constant structure functions.
status: As of November 2026 the stated local regular version is affirmative. The notebook does not specify the allowed transformations or any global quantifier; it must not be converted into a universal global abelianization conjecture. Dirac's generator equivalence is older; the constructive 1995 preprint/1996 article is a later explicit treatment.

title: Continuum confinement and the static potential
statement: In four-dimensional continuum pure non-Abelian Yang--Mills theory with external fundamental static sources, establish a well-defined subtracted static potential and a positive asymptotic string tension, \(V(r)/r\to\tau>0\) as \(r\to\infty\). The current occurrence specializes the gauge group to \(SU(3)\), at zero temperature and without dynamical fundamental quarks. This reuses the earlier pure-gauge static-potential question; it does not incorporate the stronger fixed-width hypothesis.
status: As of November 2026, strong-coupling lattice results, numerical evidence and effective-string calculations partly develop the problem; a complete continuum proof was not recovered. With light dynamical quarks, string breaking changes the asymptotic static-energy statement. The problem is distinct from, and stronger in a different direction than, simply stating a mass gap.
